target_customer: Frontier AI and robotics labs buying training data
problem: Physical manufacturing knowledge is not captured in data usable for robotics and engineering models.

founders.name: Zhichu Ren
founders.background_notes: Built robotics automation for materials research

founders.name: Will Wenbo Zhang
education: UPenn GRASP Lab, MS in AI and Robotics

technical_complexity.rationale: Capture hardware, annotation and QC pipelines in factories; operational more than research hard.

defensibility.rationale: Factory access and consented data are hard to replicate but rivals such as Build AI and Micro1 collect similar data.

market_need_then: Robotics labs sought egocentric and manipulation data; Nvidia reported benefits from first person video (2025 coverage).

pivots.from: AI virtual engineer reducing factory downtime and defects
pivots.to: Training data for robotics and frontier AI models
pivots.why: Pre-seed announcement described a factory downtime product; the current site sells datasets. Pivot date approximate and reason not stated.

outcome_analysis: Linewise raised a 1.1 million pre-seed in September 2025 as a factory AI engineer and has since repositioned as a data supplier for physical AI, now with 25 staff. No exit or distress was found. It competes with other robotics data collectors and must prove labs will pay.
notes: Round confirmed by Technode and Crowdfund Insider. One profile says total 1.6M, unverified. Competitor search returned 2025-2026 items (Build AI, Micro1), not dated at the March 2025 batch, so empty.
